# Gemini 4 Carbon

Gemini 4 Carbon (`gemini-4-carbon`) is our most capable reasoning model, built for complex software engineering, mathematical and scientific problem solving, high factual accuracy, autonomous multi-step agents, and long decode up to 1M tokens.

{% button href="https://aistudio.google.com/prompts/new_chat?model=gemini-4-carbon" variant="ais" %}Try in Google AI Studio{% /button %}

## Documentation  {% id="documentation" %}

Visit the [What's new in Gemini 4 Carbon](/docs/whats-new-gemini-4-carbon) page
for full coverage of features, API changes, and migration guidance.

## gemini-4-carbon  {% id="gemini-4-carbon" %}

{% table variant="model" %}
  * Property
  * Description

  ---

  *     {% section class="model-property" %}
  {% icon name="id_card" /%}Model code

    {% /section %}

  * `gemini-4-carbon`

  ---

  *     {% section class="model-property" %}
  {% icon name="save" /%}Supported data types

    {% /section %}

  *     **Inputs** Text, Image, Video, Audio, and PDF

    **Output** Text


  ---

  *     {% section class="model-property" %}
  {% icon name="token_auto" /%}Token limits{% sup %}[[*]](/docs/tokens){% /sup %}

    {% /section %}

  *     **Context window (unified input and output token limit)** 1,048,576

    **Max output** 65,536 (default synchronous) / up to 1,048,576 (with [long decode](/docs/long-decode))
